transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom Corporate Support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Sarah, my name is Mark Taylor. I'm calling on behalf of the Nova Retail Group. I need to discuss our upcoming mobile services bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Certainly, Mark. I can definitely help you with that. For security, could you please provide me with your company's Customer ID and the 6-digit account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Of course. The Customer ID is CUST-2007, and the security PIN is 5-0-7-4-9-8.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just one moment while I validate that... Okay, I see you're an authorized contact for Nova Retail Group. Everything looks good. So, you had a question about the bill?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes. We've hit a bit of a temporary cash flow crunch this quarter, and I was hoping we could arrange some sort of payment extension or plan for the current invoice. We want to avoid any service interruptions for our 25 mobile lines.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand that businesses can face these situations, Mark, and I appreciate you calling us proactively. Let me take a look at your account standing and the options available. Please hold for about 30 seconds.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience. Okay, I see your account has been in excellent standing with Cymbal Telecom for several years, which we really appreciate. The current invoice is for six hundred and twenty-five dollars, due next week.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's correct. It's just a bit tight to pay the full amount right on the due date.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Given your good history, we can certainly set up a payment arrangement. I have two main options. We can set a 'Promise to Pay' for a future date, or we can establish a 'Split Payment Agreement' to break the current balance into smaller parts.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The split payment agreement sounds like it might be the best fit for us. How would that work exactly?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: With that plan, we can take the current balance of six hundred twenty-five dollars and split it over your next two billing cycles. It would be added to your regular monthly charges.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, so we'd pay half of the current bill with next month's invoice, and the other half with the one after that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. That would be an additional payment of three hundred twelve dollars and fifty cents on each of your next two bills. Would that be a manageable solution for the company?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that would be a tremendous help. That works perfectly for us. Is there a fee for setting this up?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: There is no fee to set up the arrangement. And normally a late payment would incur a small penalty, but as a gesture of goodwill for being such a loyal Cymbal customer, I'm going to go ahead and waive that potential fee for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wow, Sarah, that's fantastic. Thank you so much, we really appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome. Please allow me just a moment to formalize this in the system. It will take about a minute. I will need your verbal confirmation of the terms once I've set it up.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sounds good. I'll wait.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, Mark, thank you for holding. The payment arrangement has been drafted. I just need to read it back to you for confirmation.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Ready when you are.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. This confirms that Nova Retail Group agrees to pay the current outstanding balance of six hundred twenty-five dollars in two installments of three hundred twelve dollars and fifty cents, which will be added to the next two consecutive invoices. This arrangement will prevent any service interruption and waive any late fees on the current balance. Do you agree to these terms?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I agree to those terms.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. I have just submitted it. The arrangement is now active on your account. You should receive an email confirmation to mark.taylor@novaretailgroup.com within the hour detailing these terms as well.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent. This is a big relief. Thank you again for your help, Sarah.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure to assist you, Mark. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was everything. You've been a great help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Well, thank you for being a valued customer of Cymbal Telecom. Have a great rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Bye now.
